summary: Tested new No-Stop-Loss compounding backtest feature (POST /api/portfolio/nosl + GET /api/portfolio/backtest/{job_id}) + frontend nosl-panel. All 8 backend pytest cases PASS (20s warm cache): endpoint returns {job_id,status:running,total:7}; GET on unknown id returns 404; response never leaks the asyncio 'task' field; result mode='nosl_compound' with all required fields; closed_trades == tp_wins (no SL => only TP exits); realized_balance + open_floating == true_equity within €5 tolerance (COHERENCE CHECK for the feature's key claim); return_true_percent matches (true-start)/start*100; wiped flag consistent with min_equity<=0. Frontend E2E: login demo, scroll to nosl-panel, click nosl-run-button, waited for nosl-result. Rendered values: Equity reale (MTM) €9090,24 (-9.1%), Solo trade chiusi €12.933,21 (57 TP chiusi), Perdita max -23.19% (min €9090,24), Aperte/Floating 28 / €-3842,97 non realizz. Coherence 12933.21 + (-3842.97) = 9090.24 = true_equity EXACTLY. Equity curve line chart renders. Warning text about deceptive TP-only closing is displayed. sim_symbols banner listed all 7 symbols (MetaApi disconnected during frontend run - ACCEPTABLE per request; logic still verified). nosl-wiped not shown because wiped=false (min_equity stayed positive).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py 1728 lines - still recommend splitting portfolio/nosl/optimize into routers (flagged since iter11).
_nosl_compute cleanly separates realized (event-driven, compounding lot) from MTM (daily curve) - correct implementation.
GET /portfolio/backtest/{job_id} strips the 'task' key ({k: v for k, v in job.items() if k != 'task'}) - prevents Task serialization errors. Verified explicitly in test_nosl_no_task_field_in_get.

NoslReq at line 941 uses _portfolio_jobs before its definition at line 1113; safe because module is fully loaded before any request, but consider moving _portfolio_jobs declaration above the nosl endpoint for readability.
_nosl_compute correctly clamps min lot to 0.01 and skips new entries when equity<=0, so once realized_balance is wiped no fresh trades sized on zero equity are opened.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (panel, run, result, true-equity, curve, warning, coherence all verified)
